brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo does freeze accounts. Like all UK-regulated banks, Monzo is legally required to monitor transactions

client_claims.text: Monzo's UK customer support line is 0800 802 1281 (available 24/7).
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover contact details.

client_claims.text: You can email help@monzo.com from your registered email address.
Monzo has up to 8 weeks to investigate and respond to a formal complaint.
client_claims.note: Complaint timelines are not in the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo staff are legally prohibited from telling you why your account is frozen while an investigation is underway.
You can use In-App Chat via the Help tab to contact Monzo support.
client_claims.note: App support features are not covered by the facts.
